title: Trump’s Speed on the White House Ballroom Threatens to Outpace the Courts
partialText: In his breakneck construction of a grand ballroom and in many other initiatives, critics say, the president has tried to outrun judicial review.

title: Who Approves Trump’s Washington Makeover Projects?
partialText: The Supreme Court gave a green light to the new White House ballroom, but several of the president’s other Washington projects remain stalled.

title: Trump Returns to a Familiar Playbook as the War With Iran Flares Up Again
partialText: President Trump called on Iranians to “rise up and fight” on Tuesday as the United States seems increasingly bogged down after six months of conflict.

title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln Docks in Thailand, Giving Weary Crew a Break
partialText: Thousands of sailors and Marines serve on the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln, which came into the spotlight because of a tough deployment in the war in Iran.

title: U.S. and Iran Survey the Damage After a Night of Intense Strikes
partialText: The American military said its barrage was retaliation against recent attacks on U.S. forces and marine traffic. Iranian officials said a wedding was hit and civilians killed.

title: How the Met’s Galliano Show Fell Apart
partialText: Anna Wintour put her full power and prestige behind a designer convicted of an antisemitic hate crime. Behind the scenes, influential New Yorkers revolted.

title: The ‘Miracle House’ That Survived Nepal’s Floods
partialText: People are coming to take photos of the green-painted house, which kept the Pyakurel family safe as the area all around them was destroyed by rampaging floodwaters.

title: What Is ‘Narrative Art?’ The Lucas Museum Finally Shows Us Its Vision.
partialText: After several delays, George Lucas’s legacy project is finally ready to open. There’s less “Star Wars” than you might expect.

title: In a Big Win, Google Won’t Have to Break Up Its Ad Tech Business, Court Rules
partialText: In a long-awaited decision, a federal judge said Google must change its ad tech business to address antitrust issues, but did not disclose the measures.

title: Woman Killed in Times Square Stabbing Identified as Bank of America VP
partialText: The New York Police Department is still trying to piece together what led a 49-year-old woman to stab two strangers, one fatally.

title: ‘Don’t Worry About Me’: Attacker’s Father Thought She Had Turned a Corner
partialText: Pamela Cisneros was killed by the police in Times Square after she stabbed two people, one fatally. Her father said she had stopped going with him to her mental health appointments.

title: Times Square Police Shooting Was Justified but Put Others at Risk, Experts Say
partialText: Officers who stood around a woman wielding two kitchen knives, and then opened fire without clearing the area, risked harming themselves or passers-by, the experts said.

title: Leanne Morgan, the 60-Year-Old Breakout Comedy Star
partialText: The homey Southern comic is a red-state phenomenon with blue-state celebrity, big tours, a Netflix series and Judd Apatow’s adoration. How did she get here?

title: Six Takeaways From the Massachusetts Primaries
partialText: Senator Ed Markey, 80, trounced a younger challenger who had made an argument for generational change. Two other longtime Democratic lawmakers hung on, too.

title: Billionaires Sent Montana Prices Soaring. Can Democrats Capitalize?
partialText: For years, Democrats have failed to harness the anger of Montanans contending with out-of-state wealth driving up costs. This year, a smokejumper thinks he can succeed.

title: Deaths of 2 Men in Los Angeles Police Custody Set Off Investigations
partialText: Mayor Karen Bass questioned police training to handle mental health crises after the city released graphic video footage of officers’ actions.

title: Lindsay Clancy Trial: Deadlocked Jury Deliberates for 5th Day
partialText: After roughly 28 hours of debate, jurors told the judge for a second time that they couldn’t reach unanimous agreement. He sent them back for one last try.

title: Is Steve Hilton the Future of Trumpism?
partialText: Steve Hilton wants to ‘Make California Golden Again.’

title: I Went to Princeton to Become a So-So Indian
partialText: I realized that in this country Indians were not supposed to be happy or to pursue happiness. We were supposed to suffer and to pursue suffering.

title: The Word Is Bond
partialText: We explain what is happening in the bond market.

title: Have You Felt Any Impact From Trump’s ‘Big Beautiful Bill’? Tell Us How.
partialText: To help us report upcoming stories, we want to hear whether President Trump’s signature domestic legislation has had any effect on your household budget.

title: Saturday Evening Post Will Stop Printing After 205 Years
partialText: The magazine, famous for publishing Jack London stories and Norman Rockwell art, will continue online.
